newsitem.title: USA: Dow gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in late morning trading on Tuesday as investors showed confidence that the Federal Reserve will hold the line on interest rates.
At 11:24 a.m. EDT, the 30-share Dow was up 50.64 points at 7,854.00, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
The central bank's Federal Open Market Committee convened for its sixth interest rate meeting this year at 9 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT) and is expected to announce its decision at 2:15 p.m. EDT (1815 GMT).
